thread:
maria-pm: FYI Evergreen SI hit a hard stop: marketplace validation failing when pulling replicated image into US-Gov for client Atlas. Go-live is T+1. Need quick arch triage + escalation.
dan-se: Can you paste the partner error?
maria-pm: Partner webhook: "AccessDenied: arn:aws:sts::555555555:assumed-role/evergreen-marketplace is not authorized to perform: ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer" then a later "KMS AccessDenied on Decrypt". Logs: https://s3.redwood.internal/evergreen/atlas/replicate-3181234567.log
rachel-eng: Classic cross-account ECR + KMS issue. First check: did they replicate to the gov partition (aws-us-gov) and are their CI runners using gov endpoints?
sri-sre: I'm running a quick staging repro by assuming their role. DM creds incoming.
maria-pm: Sent the short-lived creds and the role ARN.
sri-sre: Staging pull fails on GetDownloadUrlForLayer. Temporary grant of ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer + ecr:BatchGetImage scoped to repo allowed the pull to progress, then it failed on kms:Decrypt.
tia-sec: We can approve a timeboxed KMS key-policy exception for validation only, org-owner CC required. I'll standby for the emergency call. Security will require auto-revert and CloudTrail alerting.
dan-se: For minimal blast radius I used this scoped IAM snippet in staging:
```json
{
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Action":["ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer","ecr:BatchGetImage"],
  "Resource":"arn:aws-us-gov:ecr:us-gov-west-1:111111111:repository/marketplace/evergreen/*"
}
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued job 'evergreen-replicate-staging' at 20:10 UTC -> https://deploy.redwood.dev/jobs/evergreen-replicate-staging
partner-bot: partner-bot: automated webhook: staging marketplace validation failed -> AccessDenied at layer fetch.
sri-sre: After temporary KMS exception on key alias/marketplace-usg we retried and staging validation passed. Partner confirmed.
tia-sec: Approved scoped KMS exception for 3 hours with org-owner CC. Filing ticket SEC-7888 to 1) auto-revert, 2) add alerting for CrossAccountDecrypt, 3) document govcloud replication checklist.
julian-ops: If we hit a roadblock in prod, fallback is a partner-hosted AMI in the correct gov region. Not ideal, but buys time.
maria-pm: Next steps: 1) prod canary tonight (dan-se + sri-sre), 2) if green, go-live as scheduled, 3) follow-up infra work to re-encrypt-on-replication so we own gov KMS keys (rachel-eng). I'll DM partner the plan.
dan-se: I'll own the prod canary and rollback steps.
partner-bot: partner-bot: partner ran staging validation pass at 20:35 UTC and requested prod canary.
tia-sec: Security note: will verify revert and close SEC-7888 only after audit events show no further decrypts.
maria-pm: Thanks team. Filing follow-up ticket PROD-4322 for the re-encrypt migration and docs. Will update this thread after the canary. :thumbsup:
